structuralFindingsVsCheetahMara.note: Surfaced per CLAUDE.md instruction to flag structural differences rather than force this property into the Cheetah/Mara pattern.
findings: Larsens Camp has TWO distinct accommodation categories, each independently priced with its own Full Board and Ground Package tables: 'Luxury Tents' (12 tents + 2 Two-Bedroom Family Units) and 'Star-Bed Suites' (2 Deluxe Suites, children under 8 NOT allowed). Cheetah Tented Camp and Mara Bush Camp each had only ONE accommodation category on their Rack Rate pages. This extraction uses Luxury Tents (the base/standard category) — Star-Bed Suites is recorded separately below as an unpriced-in-this-quote upgrade option.

Mandatory fee structure is simpler and different in kind: a single 'Samburu Reserve fee' ($85/adult, $50/child per night) replaces Mara's two-part Community Levy + Park Fee and Cheetah's three-part Community Bed Levy + Conservation Levy + LUMO Conservation Fee.

This document (STO 30% Contract Rates) shows both a 'Rack' and a 'Net' column per season for every rate — Net is the STO 30%-discounted figure. Confirmed arithmetically: Net = Rack x 0.70 exactly across every cell checked (e.g. Full Board Peak Per Person: 525/750 = 0.70; Shoulder: 448/640 = 0.70). This is the first extraction to confirm the STO discount is a flat, exact percentage off Rack rather than an independently-set Net figure.

Larsens Camp's own Shoulder season date range was checked directly on its own page rather than assumed from Mara/Cheetah, per instruction. Result: it is identical to Mara Bush Camp's Shoulder dates (4 Jan-28 Feb & 1 Jun-30 Jun) — same underlying portfolio calendar, but this was verified independently for Larsens/Samburu, not assumed.

luxuryTents.roomNote: 12 Luxury Tents + 2 Two-Bedroom Family Units. Family tent accommodates up to 4 persons (e.g. 4 adults or 2 adults + 2 children), 2 rooms with ensuite bathrooms, shared terrace.

starBedSuites.roomNote: Two Star-Bed Suites (Deluxe Suites). Children below 8 years NOT allowed. Access to star bed platform, outdoor shower, private plunge pool.

mandatoryFees.note: Excluded from package rate above. Single combined fee, unlike Cheetah's 3-part levy or Mara's 2-part levy — see structuralFindingsVsCheetahMara.
mandatoryFees.openFlag: The document defines the child levy rate as applying to 'child under 12' but does not separately address the 12-17 Young Adult bracket for THIS fee. Treated here as adult-rate for levy purposes (since a 14-year-old does not meet the document's own 'under 12' child definition), distinct from the accommodation rate where the Young Adult gets a 75% discount. This is an interpretation, not an explicit rule stated in the source — flag on any quote using this figure for a Young Adult.
